posts.title: AI is an Affront to God
posts.description: We deserve AI. Our basic stance toward the world here in the West is to be removed from it. We are separate from the soul-deprived beasts. We have taken dominion over the Earth as was ordered. We believe our self - our character, as it once was - is created by some mostly private inner workings, and we seem to think (still!) that God is Lord, a king, a ruler, even a tyrant, telling us what to do.

posts.title: We Really Have to Talk About Capitalism, AI
posts.description: What's the context here? posts.title: I Am Become AI, Destroyer of Words
posts.description: Words abstracted die. This is not tragedy. This is not comedy. This is plain fact. I don't mean that they stop being meaningful.
